name: ship-check
description: A development verification board: shows which tests, builds and type checks really ran, how they ended, and whether the result still matches your code.

extra_checks.title: Extra checks
extra_checks.description: Your own check commands, one per entry, written as kind=command. Example: lint=npm run lint

extra_ignored_paths.title: Ignored paths
extra_ignored_paths.description: Folders or files whose changes should not make a result Stale. Example: generated
